messages.content: Someone in my church told me about SafeVault fixed savings. It is a fixed savings plan in a savings app that is registered with the SEC. You lock your money for a period you choose. It pays up to 22% a year if you lock for 365 days, and the interest is paid upfront when you lock. I've already been paid twice and everyone I know in it is happy. I'm putting 300,000 naira in. Make me a simple table of how my money grows over the next 12 months so I can plan.

My cousin told me about our street ajo. It is a rotating savings group (ajo) of 8 people on our street. Everyone contributes every week and one person collects the pot each week. Each person pays 13,000 naira a week, so whoever collects that week gets 104,000 naira. There is no interest: over 8 weeks you pay 104,000 naira and collect 104,000 naira once. I've already been paid twice and everyone I know in it is happy. I'm putting 13,000 naira in. Make me a simple table of how my money grows over two full rounds of the group so I can plan.
